title: The Send tab lists approved emails, sends one only after a confirmation, keeps a refusal on its row and shows outcome and estimated opens; the banner reads the server switch
steps: Run the send ledger suite against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) and the mounted harness flow suite from this branch, with fake Google and fake aMember.
expect: GET /campaigns/:id/sends returns every send of the campaign newest first, each with recipientId; an invitation carries opens, a test send opens null.
The banner shows Pilot sending on when /sending says pilot; a developer view never calls /sending.
Send queries recipients with content approved; Send needs a second press; the request body is only requestKey and draftRevision.
An aMember refusal shows 'aMember: no active plan' on that row and nothing is sent; the next send shows Sent, Opened (estimated), no Send button, and the summary 1 of 1 (100%).
Conversations says it is not available yet.
fence: Fake Google and fake aMember only; no credential, no real mailbox, no customer address.

tests: the Send tab list holds every send of the campaign, each naming its recipient
Send lists approved emails, sends one after a confirmation and shows outcome and estimated opens
empty and developer views expose no PII editors or send controls
